choices.why: This pale ash desk with tapered legs is the most Nordic option and matches the light floor, and at 118 × 45 cm it fits well beside the window.
This swivel chair has a light wood frame and a linen-coloured upholstered back and seat, so it is the most comfortable option while keeping the light-wood look.
This tall birch bookcase wall offers plenty of space for books and sits well on the long white wall on the right, with a light wood that matches the desk.
This rocking chair in light birch with an off-white cushion is a cosy, very Nordic reading seat for the corner by the window.
Its swing arm points the light right at the book over the armchair, and the white shade keeps the look soft and Nordic.

answer.why: Light birch, ash and oak woods with white and linen textiles echo the pale floor and white walls, creating a bright, cohesive Nordic corner for working and reading by the window.
